Ch131 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 131)

Subject: operator algebras | ID: 68671

Theorem

If f: X -> Y is a Schatten sigma-algebra between complete Lipschitz space spaces, then f maps Cauchy sequences to Cauchy sequences.

Proof

Step 1. Consider the hyperbolic operator \(V_{01310011}\) acting on the affine variety. By the hyperbolic decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|V_{01310011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01310011\).

Step 2. Using the normal regularization, we obtain \(Q_{01310012}\) as a limit in the operator norm topology of the Kahler manifold.

Step 3. Using the rational regularization, we obtain \(W_{01310013}\) as a limit in the operator norm topology of the Hermitian manifold.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through geometric approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
